_about: B6990: settings for the runner on the Secondary PC (BENJAMIN-PC, Ryzen 7 3800X 8 cores, 16 GB, RTX 2080 Super 8 GB). Keys here replace runner.json's. It drives lane 8 only, runs no book or Trove lookups (those files are on the Main PC), runs no stale-PR sweep (the main runner does), and watches the live site and the main runner. B7500 (19 Nov): this runner drove the merge train while the Main PC was down with a hardware fault. B7620 (22 Nov): the Main PC is repaired and drives the train again, so train is off here; it gates on lane 8 only. B7761 (23 Nov): prGatesDeferMinutes leaves a pull request's whole-branch gate run to the Main PC or the New PC, which have more lanes, for 10 minutes before this runner takes it.
